mapper.select: SELECT d.dname AS "deptName", COUNT(l.sabun) AS "count" FROM sleave_log l JOIN sawon s ON l.sabun = s.sabun JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno WHERE l.use_date = #{today} AND l.approve = 1 GROUP BY d.dname
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sleave_log WHERE approve = 0

SELECT s.saname, d.dname, l.leave_type, l.use_date, l.use_days, l.reason, l.created_at FROM sleave_log l JOIN sawon s ON l.sabun = s.sabun JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno WHERE l.approve = 1 ORDER BY l.approved_at DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sleave_log WHERE approve = 1 AND DATE(approved_at) = CURDATE()

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sabun) FROM sleave_log WHERE approve = 1 AND use_date <= CURDATE() AND ( DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), use_date) + 1 - (FLOOR((DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), use_date) + WEEKDAY(use_date)) / 7) * 2) - (CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(use_date) = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN WEEKDAY(CURDATE()) = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ) <= use_days

SELECT l.log_id, l.sabun, s.saname AS saname, d.dname AS dname, l.leave_type, l.use_date, l.use_days, l.reason, l.created_at, l.approve FROM sleave_log l INNER JOIN sawon s ON l.sabun = s.sabun LEFT JOIN dept d ON s.deptno = d.deptno WHERE l.approve = false ORDER BY l.created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sleave_log WHERE sabun = #{sabun} AND approve = 0
